scenario: LSER.6.8.1 — labeled series observations are accessed via `<binding>.<label>.<agg>`. Pin: a series with two labelled `mean` lines (`recent` / `hourly`) resolves both `s.recent.mean` and `s.hourly.mean` to the per-line window. Each path desugars to `mean(s.val, <line-window-ns>)`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable
    ts: Time

series Sensor.val:
    mean sliding 10_min as recent
    mean sliding 1_h as hourly

rule check_recent:
    Sensor s where s.recent.mean > 100.0
->
    log info "recent high"

rule check_hourly:
    Sensor s where s.hourly.mean > 50.0
->
    log info "hourly high"
